scope: Parse morphology boundaries, source words and AF aliases, and encode/decode the prefix-compressed WCAFF2 stem stream in first-party code. Compact and common source flag fields borrow their input. Check the word budget before extending the prefix buffer. Rule header directives, dictionary indexes and language adapters still have imported production code. Existing WCAFF2 reserves literal slash as its stem/flag delimiter.
method: 111 source sets including 75 released packs checked on each platform and through all four compact writer-reader pairs. All archives and both writer byte hashes verified. 24 retained differences with Hunspell concern terminal blanks or non-BMP letters with IGNORE enabled; previous and current Word are identical. For the official reference only, four erroneous rule header counts in three archives were adjusted on disposable copies.
timingMethod: Seven alternating optimized pairs per input. Source timings exclude decoding and disk I/O and include dictionary indexing. Compact timings include launching the checker, loading and inflating identical bytes, and building indexes. UOS pinned to CPU 3.
